title: Billing operations overview
body: Billing is the invoice and subscription ledger. When billing is operational, invoice generation and dunning run on schedule in us-east-1. Check p99 latency if operators report delayed invoices.

title: Payments current status notes
body: Payments is currently operational in us-east-1. There is no active payments incident. Checkout should complete at normal card-auth latency.

title: Payments remediation runbook
body: When payments status is degraded, open the PAY-2041 remediation path: inspect card-auth latency, pause non-critical retries, and notify enterprise operators about slower checkout. Do not recommend this path when payments is operational.

title: Payments recent deployment
body: The latest payments deployment was a configuration rollback in us-east-1. No open incident is attached. Use this note when payments is healthy but operators still want a change-risk check.

title: Canonical service names
body: Status tooling accepts canonical service names only: billing, payments, auth. Do not use aliases such as billing-api or billing-svc.
